//: Seekins Precision SP10 Match in 6.5mm Creedmoor. Same niche as the MRGG-S but a 22-inch heavy match barrel: longer and heavier, slightly better reach, slightly worse recoil control. Default rifle for the CAG sniper when that profession lands (Phase 2).
description: The Seekins Precision SP10-M is a large-frame precision AR in 6.5mm Creedmoor built around a 22-inch heavy match barrel.  It out-reaches the MRGG-S by a hair and rewards a stable, supported position, but all that steel hanging off the front makes it slower to drive between targets and harsher to run fast.  Feeds from the same magazines as the MRGG.
